role: Source preparation, not final source auditor

scope.edition: Fantasy Flight Games original English 2008 CE01
scope.excluded: Expansions, Anniversary/later variants, flares as alien powers, summary/questions/key/readers

image_inspection.method: All 50 original_file images individually opened with tools.view_image and visibly inspected in ten alphabetic groups of five.

deviations.action: While trying to locate the extracted rulebook, searched only under docs and read first 6000 characters of historical initial-shared-files/extracted/cosmic-encounter-rules.txt.
deviations.disposition: Recognized non-original 51-alien content, reported to parent; parent supplied canonical absolute path. Historical text abandoned, no operative catalog claims derived from it. Canonical rulebook then read in full.

issues: Canonical rulebook p9 gives ties to defense; sheet changes lower-total winning condition but does not restate ties. No variant rule imported.
Equal attack card values are not expressly described.
Placement after destiny drawn and Planning-only highlight are consistent with p4/p12 distinction: placement is a non-use clause; activating is the use. Check FAQ only for specific interactions.
If opponent has attacks but none of equal/higher value, obligation needs rulebook/FAQ interpretation.

important_use_distinctions: Citadel: placement not use; activation is use.
Miser: hoard refresh/protection not explicitly use.
Warrior: adding tokens cannot be zapped; adding attack bonus is use.
Vulch: keeping revealed old artifacts while drawing eight new cards not use.
Zombie: freeing ships in deal cannot be zapped; preventing warp loss is use.
Human: zapping makes its side win; Loser upset resolves after this.
Masochist: all-ships-lost victory is a use at regroup before retrieval; home-colony immunity is separate.
Kamikaze: zapped use does not sacrifice ships.
remaining_work: Parent to reconcile FAQs and any interactions, then design/repair summary and questions; no final source readiness verdict made.
